cookieInformation: With your permission, we send page-view events to PostHog. Events contain the registered page address without query strings or fragments, an event-specific random identifier and a timestamp. We do not send form values or identify visitors. Session replay and automatic interaction tracking are not used. Analytics requests omit browser credentials and referrer information. PostHog receives network information needed to deliver the request; we request that IP-based location enrichment is disabled. You can reject analytics or withdraw permission through Privacy settings. Withdrawal stops future events; it does not delete events already received by PostHog. See our <policy>cookie policy</policy> for browser storage and external-service details.
